wands-ace: A curious ginger-and-cream kitten on a rocky hill at twilight reaches one paw toward a single budding golden wand planted in the earth. A tiny flame at the wand tip lights its face; spring leaves and subtle glowing sparks suggest the first spark of creative energy.
wands-2: A tabby cat stands on a castle balcony, one paw on a small globe; two flowering golden wands frame the distant horizon and branching roads, a choice of future paths.
wands-3: A ginger cat gazes out over a river valley from a sunlit promontory while three tall budding wands stand nearby; tiny sailboats return on the distant water, patient expansion.
wands-4: Four flowering wands form a festive arch over two cats reunited in a garden courtyard, garlands and a warmly lit home behind them, communal celebration.
wands-5: Five playful young cats in a sunlit meadow each hold a different slender wooden wand in a lively mock contest, dynamic but harmless crossed motions.
wands-6: A proud tabby cat rides gently through a village on a small pony, wearing a laurel wreath and carrying a flowered wand; five other wands line the path, warm welcome and recognition.
wands-7: A determined cat on a rocky high ledge plants one flowering wand firmly while six other wands rise from below, a brave stance and guarded boundary.
wands-8: Eight slim glowing wands streak diagonally across a starry dusk sky over a valley; a small cat on a hill watches their swift passage, travel and news in motion.
wands-9: A weathered but gentle cat with a small bandage sits before a fence of eight upright wooden wands, holding a ninth; dawn light signals resilience and needed rest.
wands-10: A strong cat carries a heavy tied bundle of ten flowering wands toward a home in the distance; another cat waits at the gate ready to help, weight and sharing.
wands-page: A curious young kitten in a travel cloak discovers a single budding golden wand in a desert garden at dawn, eyes bright with possibilities; exploratory page.
wands-knight: An energetic ginger cat mounted on a spirited chestnut pony carries a flowering wand across a warm desert plain beneath a starry sky; forward momentum.
wands-queen: A regal warm tabby queen cat seated among sunflowers holds a flowering wand, a black kitten at her feet, warm confidence and abundant creative energy.
wands-king: A majestic ginger king cat wearing a subtle crown sits on a stone throne carved with lions, holds one flowering wand, looking toward a glowing city, responsible vision.
cups-ace: A white kitten reaches toward a single ornate golden chalice overflowing into a clear pool, lilies, doves and golden moonlight suggesting a new emotional beginning.
cups-2: Two affectionate cats face one another across a little stream and touch two ornate golden cups, a luminous ribbon arcs between them, equal affection and mutual listening.
cups-3: Three friendly cats gather in a garden beneath a crescent moon, each with one golden chalice raised gently in celebration, flowers and fruit around them.
cups-4: One thoughtful cat sits beneath an old tree beside three untouched cups; a fourth golden cup offered on a soft cloud catches a sliver of light, introspection and missed opportunity.
cups-5: A sad cat beside a river looks at three overturned chalices while two still-standing cups glimmer behind it; a narrow bridge and warm lights across the river offer hope.
cups-6: Two kittens share a flower-filled cup in a village garden, four more flower cups nearby and a sixth at the gate; gentle childhood memory and kindness.
cups-7: A dreaming cat on a rocky hill watches seven glowing cups floating in clouds, each holding a different possibility: laurel, jewel, flower, castle, star, veil, dragon shadow.
cups-8: A solitary cat walks away from eight stacked chalices beside a moonlit shore toward distant mountains; quiet purposeful search for something more meaningful.
cups-9: A contented well-fed cat sits comfortably before a curved display of nine golden cups in a richly textured room, a grateful private moment under soft stars.
cups-10: A cat family with two kittens in a blooming valley beneath a rainbow formed by ten golden cups, warm home beside a river and shared joy.
cups-page: A dreamy young kitten on a sea shore looks into a single ornate cup where a tiny fish peeks out, gentle surprise and emotional curiosity.
cups-knight: A gracious cream cat rides a calm white pony along a stream, offering one golden cup with both front paws, quiet romantic invitation.
cups-queen: A graceful long-haired queen cat rests on a seashell throne by moonlit water, holding one elaborately covered chalice, empathic contemplation.
cups-king: A steady silver cat king sits on a stone throne at sea, waves and a small ship around him; one chalice in his paw, composed emotional wisdom.
swords-ace: A single brilliant silver sword held aloft by a cat's paw emerges from a misty cloud, crowned with a laurel wreath; a small tabby cat below gazes at the clear beam of truth.
swords-2: A pale cat sits blindfolded on a moonlit stone shore holding two crossed silver swords, tidal waters and two islands behind, careful balancing and an unseen choice.
swords-3: A cat shelters from rain under a flowering tree, a glowing red heart-shaped crystal above is pierced symbolically by three silver swords; sorrow and eventual healing, no gore.
swords-4: A sleeping tabby cat rests in a quiet chapel alcove beneath a stained-glass window, three swords mounted above and one laid beside its bed; sacred restorative pause.
swords-5: One cat stands alone after a quarrel with three gathered swords while two other cats walk away beneath a windy dusk sky, two swords left on wet ground; hollow victory.
swords-6: A cat ferries another cat and kitten across still moonlit water in a small boat with six silver swords standing safely in the bow, travel toward calmer shore.
swords-7: A sly cat tiptoes from a camp carrying five silver swords, two remain planted behind; dawn light reveals an uncertain expression, strategy and conscience.
swords-8: A frightened cat stands gently entangled in loose silk ribbons among eight upright silver swords; its path out is visible beyond, fear and choice, no harm.
swords-9: A worried cat sits awake on an embroidered bed under a midnight window with nine slender silver swords displayed along the wall, starry night and anxious thoughts.
swords-10: A cat lies exhausted but safe on a dawn-lit hillside while ten swords stand planted in the ground behind, not touching it; sunrise signals the end of a hard chapter.
swords-page: A keen-eyed young cat on a windswept hill holds one slender silver sword up to the bright sky, leaves whirling; alert curiosity.
swords-knight: A decisive silver cat rides a white pony at speed through clouds and wind with one silver sword raised, dynamic but graceful, momentum and clarity.
swords-queen: A poised queen cat on a high stone throne holds one upright silver sword, an open paw extended with quiet honesty; clear sky and drifting clouds.
swords-king: A wise gray king cat on a carved mountain throne holds a straight silver sword, balanced scales and star charts nearby; reason and just responsibility.
pentacles-ace: A calico kitten discovers a single large golden pentacle emerging among flowers in a walled garden, open gate leads to a distant mountain path, tangible new opportunity.
pentacles-2: A nimble kitten juggles two golden pentacles connected by a looping infinity ribbon beside a busy harbor, ships rocking on waves, flexible balance.
pentacles-3: Three cats collaborate inside a vaulted artisan workshop on a stained-glass design featuring three golden pentacles above, one sketches, one carves, one reviews.
pentacles-4: A cat sits protectively atop a small chest holding one golden pentacle, two under its paws and one above its crown; a safe town in the distance, security and control.
pentacles-5: Two cold and tired cats pass a warm illuminated window with five golden pentacles in its stained glass, snow falls softly, help within reach.
pentacles-6: A generous cat offers a food parcel to another cat and kitten beneath a hanging balance scale; six golden pentacles decorate the garden doorway, dignified giving.
pentacles-7: A patient cat in a lush orchard examines a vine bearing seven golden pentacles, small garden spade nearby, evening light and careful assessment of growth.
pentacles-8: A dedicated young cat at an artisan workbench engraves a golden pentacle, seven finished pentacles neatly displayed on the wall; focus and repetition.
pentacles-9: An elegant independent cat strolls in a ripe vineyard holding a little falcon, nine golden pentacles glimmer among the vines, earned comfort and freedom.
pentacles-10: An elder cat, two adult cats and a kitten gather in the courtyard of a long-loved home; ten golden pentacles set in an arch and floor mosaic, generational support.
pentacles-page: A studious young cat holds one golden pentacle carefully in a spring meadow, notebook and gardening tools nearby, learning through practical action.
pentacles-knight: A patient sturdy cat rides a calm dark pony along a fertile field, holding one golden pentacle; planted furrows toward a distant home, steady work.
pentacles-queen: A nurturing queen cat in a verdant garden cradles a golden pentacle while a kitten rests nearby, fruit trees and herbs show grounded care.
pentacles-king: A stately king cat on a vine-carved throne holds a golden pentacle, orchard and stable behind, abundant harvest and fair stewardship.
